name: amplifier-capability-delivery-packager
promise: Package exactly an approved local asset allowlist with author declarations and byte-integrity metadata.

native.contract: delivery-plan/v1 and delivery-package/v1; explicit preview fingerprint required for build

writes: Explicit selected native-file or discovery destination only

runtime.writes: One new archive plus temporary private staging at explicitly selected existing destination; no overwrite.

dataflow.installation: Pinned tracked source only; no automatic account or provider configuration.
dataflow.runtime: Selected local regular files enter a new local ZIP; a local verifier reads it without extraction or upload.

source_policy.revision: Use an explicit full Git commit.
source_policy.research: .research/market is ignored local material; public cards are separately curated.
source_policy.rights: Original MIT code and methods; user material retains its own rights.

publication_status: Prepared local source; owner separately verifies and publishes repository and guide.
